mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically leads to increased wage pressures and subsequently, positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases over a 3-month period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential economic slowdown due to restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with low GDP growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 250,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 250k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals robust consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS drops > 0.25% MoM.
